summary: Frontend-only test of updated /termos.html (VUNESP / Vestibular Unesp 2027) on desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844, plus homepage regression. All requested checks passed.

issues: At 390px the Institucional / Recrutamento Vunesp / Área do Candidato links are hidden and there is no hamburger to reach them (only the logo shows). It's the same on the homepage, so termos matches it. Low priority.

action_items: Optional: remove the public backup files /app/frontend/public/termos.html.seducbak, termos.html.oldbak, inicio.html.seducbak and cev-logo.png. They can still be fetched by URL and contain old CEV/SEDUC content.
critical_code_review_comments: home_extra.html loader script is shared by / and /termos.html; a.home-menu-link handlers -> loader -> '/' after 2s, works correctly.
Category submenu items open on click of #ancora-concurso etc. (not on hover) on desktop; same as homepage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: no CEV/SEDUC/Ceará in visible text of /termos.html (the regex hits in the raw HTML come from base64 data only); header and footer innerText are identical to '/'; card text checks out (Vestibular Unesp 2027, 04/09-20/10, 5.850, TERMOS DE INSCRIÇÃO | VESTIBULAR UNESP 2027, 20/10/2026 às 23h59); CONTINUAR stays disabled until termos-checkbox is checked, then goes to /inscricao.html (desktop+mobile); VOLTAR goes to /; menu-concurso-0 (after clicking #ancora-concurso on desktop, or the CONCURSOS tile on mobile) shows home-loader then goes to /; 0 external http(s) hrefs; scrollWidth=390 on mobile; homepage INSCREVA-SE shows loader then goes to /termos.html. Use wait_until='load'. Playwright force-click on a submenu item while the dropdown is closed does nothing (it lands on the element on top), so open the dropdown first.
